v1VsV2.answer: Version-agnostic. Key off child thread_id, NOT the engine-specific spawn event. v1 Collab spawn events (CollabAgentSpawnBegin/End) are DROPPED at the app-server, so they are invisible at the tap; v2 emits SubAgentActivity. But both create real child threads whose item/turn notifications flow (auto-attach) tagged with thread_id, so the identity/mapping mechanism covers both. v1 (Collab) is default-ON = the common case works out of the box.

currentMappingGap.note: mapping.rs is thread-blind today: map_notification reads only turn_id (never thread_id), and envelope() hardcodes subagent:None. So child events already get flattened into the parent transcript in a top-level remote session (Collab default-on) as a latent bug. The new feature fixes this and must coordinate to not regress top-level auto-attach.

directions.summary: Overlay-only nested sidechain wedge: ControlState child registry (thread_id -> minted cuid2), synthesize a parent Agent/Task tool-call, make mapping.rs thread-aware (tag child-thread envelopes subagent:<cuid2>), reuse Happy's existing Task-sidechain UI; new default-off Feature::RemoteSubagentSessions; reuse existing happy_tap seam.
pros: Zero app / happy-wire / happy-server changes — reuses existing subagent/sidechain/TaskView machinery already shipped in the app
Reuses the existing tap seam (app.rs:1254) — no new TUI seam, top-level tap invariants untouched
Self-contained in inbound.rs + mapping.rs + small attach.rs wiring (files the raw-session ship already owns)
Version-agnostic (keys off thread_id, covers v1 default-on and v2 identically)
Fixes the latent child-flattening bug as a side effect of becoming thread-aware
Correct UX: matches Claude-Code Task nesting
cons: Requires minting a cuid2 in the overlay (small dep/helper)
Requires a synthetic parent tool-call whose clean rendering (no tool-call-end) needs validation
Gate-off suppression is a behavior change to the shipped top-level path (needs operator ack)

directions.summary: Flat tag only: tag child-thread envelopes with subagent:<cuid2> but do NOT synthesize a parent Agent/Task tool-call.
pros: Slightly less code than D-001 (no synthetic tool-call)
cons: App nests a sidechain ONLY under a parent tool-call whose input.sessionSubagent matches (reducerTracer.ts:121-132); with no parent, sidechain messages have parentUUID set but no anchor -> likely orphaned/hidden, so children may not render at all
Does not deliver visible nesting; effectively worse than the status quo for the child transcript

directions.summary: Separate Happy session per child: open a new SessionClient/session per subagent thread so each child appears as its own top-level session.
pros: Children get full independent session UIs
cons: The session wire has NO parent->child session link — children would be disconnected flat sessions with no nesting/relationship
Much heavier: multiplies daemon/session/pairing churn per child
Does not match the north-star two-plane model or the Task-nesting UX
Large new surface vs the overlay-only wedge

directions.summary: Standalone gate-off fix only: suppress child-thread events when the feature is OFF to remove today's flattening, without building nesting.
pros: Tiny; removes the confusing flatten immediately
Is effectively a sub-decision of D-001's gate-off behavior (M-F)
cons: Does not surface children at all (the actual goal); only a cleanup
Best folded INTO D-001 as its gate-off branch rather than shipped alone

milestones: M-A · Add default-off Feature::RemoteSubagentSessions (Experimental) mirroring Feature::RemoteSession in features/src/lib.rs; fork-visibility test; patch-surface §14 row + §15 replant note.

M-B · Child registry in ControlState (inbound.rs): HashMap<child_thread_id, cuid2> + register_child/child_cuid2; populate on ThreadStarted{parent_thread_id:Some} (primary path) and first non-primary item/turn thread_id (fallback); cuid2 mint helper. Unit tests.

M-C · Thread-aware outbound mapping (mapping.rs): thread &ControlState into map_event/map_notification/map_item_*; read thread_id; primary -> subagent:None, child -> subagent:Some(cuid2); envelope() takes a subagent arg (drop hardcoded None at :184). Unit tests.

M-D · Synthetic parent tool-call: on child registration emit one ToolCallStart(name:'Agent', args.sessionSubagent=cuid2, args.prompt=label, args.subagent_type=agent_path|'subagent') on the primary turn. Unit test.

M-E · Wire into both drain sites (attach.rs:275 pre-connect + attach.rs:401 connected): pass &control into mapping; reuse existing happy_tap seam (app.rs:1254), no new TUI seam; gate all child behavior on Feature::RemoteSubagentSessions.

M-F · Gate-off coordination / do-not-regress: when OFF suppress non-primary-thread envelopes (fixes today's flatten, preserves top-level parity); flag the behavior change for operator ack; when ON, nest.
M-G · (defer) Optional child lifecycle enrichment: start{title}/stop{} + child turn-end tagged with cuid2 (app currently drops start/stop, typesRaw.ts:568-570).

M-H · Patch-surface + audit closeout: §14 row; confirm zero new upstream-canonical seam (tap reused); wire-drift guard (US-008) unaffected (subagent field pre-exists); cargo check --workspace + overlay cargo test.
openQuestions: Q-1 (needs operator ack): when the feature is OFF, suppress child-thread events (cleaner top-level parity but a behavior change to the shipped path) vs keep today's flatten? Recommendation: suppress.

Q-2: which crate/impl mints a cuid2 in the overlay? App strictly requires subagent to be cuid2 (sessionProtocol.ts:140); envelope id is unconstrained. Add a small dep/vendored generator and confirm it passes isCuid.

Q-3: is ThreadStarted delivered to the in-process tap for auto-attached subagent threads, or only their item/turn notifications? If not, registration relies on the first-non-primary-item/turn fallback (design covers both).

Q-4: does a synthetic Agent/Task tool-call with no matching tool-call-end render cleanly in TaskView (or spin forever)? Is name:'Agent' or 'Task' the better label? Validate vs reducerTracer + TaskView.
Q-5: nesting depth — fork gates spawn_agent from SubAgent sessions (top-level-only) and v1 depth-strips, so v1 default is practically depth-1; v2 can go deeper. Scope depth-1 first.
Q-6: confirm map_item_completed (mapping.rs:107) yields a readable Text envelope for the child's final AgentMessage once tagged (same code path, just tagged).
